conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: The Eisenhower Matrix helps categorize tasks by urgency and importance, guiding you to focus on what truly matters. It divides tasks into four quadrants to aid in prioritization.

conversation.message: Could you explain what those four quadrants are?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly. The quadrants are: Urgent/Important, Not Urgent/Important, Urgent/Not Important, and Not Urgent/Not Important.
